description: This file implements the HealthcheckServiceFactory class, which creates instances of IHealthcheckService with a specified health check interval. It includes methods for constructing the factory and creating health check service objects, referencing external classes such as HealthcheckService and ITimer.

classes.name: HealthcheckServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating health check service instances with a specified interval.

methods.name: HealthcheckServiceFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with a health check interval.

methods.name: createHealthcheckService
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of IHealthcheckService, configured with the provided app manager and timer factory.
